description.text: The camera holds a static medium wide shot of a small shop counter at closing time. The counter is a worn wooden ledge with a dark ledger open near the center, a slim pen resting beside it, and a low cash box pushed to one side. Behind the counter, the shop recedes into shadowed shelving and a shuttered front window; the light is cool and level, with a faint warm bulb above the ledger giving the wood a dull sheen. The man at the counter stands squarely behind the ledger in a plain dark shirt, one hand resting on the open page. He is composed and unhurried, his gaze angled down at the paper before he lifts his attention toward the customer side. The camera remains fixed. The room is quiet except for a low room tone and the soft shift of the ledger page. He speaks the single supplied line once, flatly and without hurry, then holds still as the words land. No visible text is added; the ledger and counter remain ordinary working objects. The man's posture stays relaxed, his free hand loose at his side, and the empty customer side of the counter keeps the scene open and still.
